capture: Actual native CoreAudio mixer output, one 26-second scripted battle-audio scenario per faction. Calm score, routine weapons, heavy weapons, base warning plus vehicle destruction, then quiet recovery. Each faction uses a 35-second score seek.

speech_recognition.model: OpenAI Whisper medium.en, local CPU FP32, temperature 0, English, no initial prompt or previous-text conditioning

limits: No human listening or subjective sound-quality acceptance was possible through available tools.
This is one moderate observed-combat scenario per faction, not maximum-population mixer stress.
AudioEffectRecord captures after bus effects and before that bus volume; Master recording is before the master 0.8 gain.
Bus recorders were stopped sequentially, so their trailing quiet lengths differ by up to 0.43 seconds. Warning excerpts share the same recording start and are cropped to 11.5–16 seconds.
Automatic speech recognition is evidence about this warning and scenario; it does not establish human intelligibility for all lines or mixes.
